Are you passionate about software development, engineering applications, and solving complex technical challenges? Join us as a Software Application Engineer and play a key role in developing innovative software solutions that make a real impact across the marine industry.
As a Software Application Engineer – Control Systems, you are responsible for developing new or adapting existing software for our control system contracts and development projects.
What you will be doing
The main task is the development and adaptation of control and automation application software for marine control systems. The software development is mainly done with function block programming in AutoCAD. Knowledge of C, Java and MATLAB Simulink is advantageous.
In this role you will work in close collaboration with project managers, application engineers, suppliers and our customers. Your main task will be to customize software according to individual customer requirements. In this role you will also provide technical support to our sales and service organization when necessary.
No matter if you're just starting out or have a few years of experience, we're here to help you grow. We are all about hands-on challenges and support to help you become the best Software Application Engineer you can be, right from the start of your career. We're all about fostering a creative, collaborative vibe where everyone can bring their ideas to the table.
We think you should have
To succeed in this position, you have a degree in engineering in the field of automation, electronics, data science, control theory or similar, and ideally previous experience in development and software design for automation systems. General experience of electrical design and marine operations is an advantage. Additional knowledge/experience in: AutoCad, C, Java, MATLAB Simulink and Linux is also advantageous. Due to the nature of our international customer and supplier base, a high level of both spoken and written English is necessary. Communication skills in other languages are advantageous.
At Kongsberg Maritime, we believe that diversity fuels innovation. We encourage you to apply, even if you do not meet every requirement. Your unique perspective is valuable to us. Your skills, attitude and perspective could be exactly what we are looking for!
We review applications on an ongoing basis and may conduct interviews before the closing date, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. Candidates progressing in the process may be invited to complete personality and aptitude assessments.
Kongsberg Maritime works with customers across both commercial and naval markets. As this role is subject to export control regulations, citizenship-related questions will be included in the recruitment process. Employment is conditional upon the successful completion of a pre-employment screening in accordance with company security standards.
Why join us
We offer flexible working hours and the option to work remote or from home office.
Start your career through development programs and mentorship from industry leaders.
Work on exciting projects that are shaping the future of the maritime industry.

Kongsberg Maritime is a global leader in maritime technology. We deliver advanced solutions to the merchant fleet, offshore, fishing, and naval vessels, setting new standards for safe, efficient, and sustainable operations - both for new builds and existing fleets. In close collaboration with customers and research environments, we develop technology that solves real challenges at sea. Today, more than 30,000 vessels operate with our systems on board. Kongsberg Maritime has more than 8,300 employees in 35 countries.
Our Propulsion and Handling division delivers world class products for propulsion, handling systems and waterjet for all marine industry sectors including merchant, offshore and naval. Our products enhance operational efficiency and deliver safe, secure, reliable and sustainable products to our valued customers.
Technologies for sustainable oceans

Mpya Sci & Tech was created by and for people who love technology and science. We’re not here to do what everyone else is doing. We believe that real talent lies in individuals who dare to keep growing throughout their entire lives. With extensive experience and deep industry knowledge, we’ve built a forward-leaning and cutting-edge company—our way. At Mpya Sci & Tech, we believe in a sustainable working life where we build a culture together based on genuine involvement, eager curiosity, and the freedom to be yourself. Learn more at: www.mpyascitech.com .
Would you like to develop and improve purification processes for complex proteins and help develop future medicines?
At Mpya Sci & Tech, we are looking for someone with solid experience in downstream process development and protein purification. You have a strong technical background, enjoy solving complex problems and like finding new solutions when existing methods are not enough.
As a consultant at Mpya Sci & Tech, you will have the opportunity to use your expertise in development projects at pharmaceutical and biotech companies. Your assignments may range from early-stage process development to optimization and scale-up ahead of manufacturing.
About the role
You will develop, optimize and troubleshoot purification processes for recombinant proteins and other biological molecules. This may involve developing new purification strategies, improving yield and product quality, or solving challenges related to aggregation, adsorption, instability and product loss.
Your work will include:
Developing and optimizing purification processes using chromatography and filtration.
Improving protein purity, stability, activity and yield.
Planning and evaluating experiments and analyzing results.
Troubleshooting processes and making them more robust, with future scale-up and GMP manufacturing in mind.

You will work closely with other specialists and contribute your expertise to developing reliable and practical process solutions.
Who are we looking for?
We are looking for someone with:
A relevant university degree in Life Science, preferably a PhD in biotechnology, biochemistry, chemical engineering or a related field.
Several years of experience in downstream process development and protein purification.
Hands-on experience with chromatography and filtration, such as ultrafiltration and diafiltration (UF/DF).
Experience working in a GMP-regulated environment within the development or manufacturing of biological medicines.
Experience working with CMOs/CDMOs in process development or manufacturing.
The ability to drive development work independently, analyze results and solve complex technical problems.
Excellent written and spoken in Swedish and English.

Experience in purifying challenging proteins and enzymes, scaling up processes and process validation is an advantage. Experience with regulatory documentation for biological medicines is also beneficial.
You are analytical, curious and solution-oriented. You enjoy solving technical challenges, take initiative and work well both independently and as part of a team.
How to apply
Interested in this role or curious about working as a consultant with us? Send us your application today! We interview candidates on an ongoing basis, and the position may be filled before the application deadline. Application deadline: 23/11. If you have any questions, please contact Jasmin Khatibi  (jasmin.khatibi@mpyascitech.com, +46 76 163 63 00) or Johan Östman (johan.ostman@mpyascietch or +46 76 628 78 91)                                  .
Why Mpya Sci & Tech?
Mpya Sci & Tech was founded by people who love science and technology, for people who share that passion. Many of us have backgrounds in industry and consulting, so we know how important it is to find the right match, have support throughout your assignment and work for an employer who listens.
At Mpya, you can be yourself. Our office feels like a shared living room, and our culture is built on curiosity, openness and respect.
Read more at www.mpyascitech.com.
Does this sound like a role for you? We look forward to hearing from you!

Make It with Pride — Join Mondelēz International
At Mondelēz International, we empower people to snack right. We are one of the world's leading snack companies, home to iconic brands loved around the globe — including Milka, Oreo, Toblerone, and Marabou. Our purpose is to lead the future of snacking by offering the right snack, for the right moment, made the right way.
For our Upplands Väsby plant, home of Marabou, Daim, Oboy and pralines we are now looking for a Maintenance Engineer to join our Asset Reliability team and play a key role in driving equipment reliability, availability, and cost-effective maintenance across our site.
About the Role
As a Maintenance Engineer, you will be responsible for ensuring equipment reliability and availability through strategic preventive and predictive maintenance, aligned with our IL6S (Integrated Lean 6 Sigma) strategy. Working closely with PM Planners, Maintenance Technicians, CI Engineers, Process Engineers, and the QA department, you will develop and improve our maintenance processes — with the ultimate goal of zero breakdowns and cost-efficient maintenance.
What You'll Do
Maintenance Strategy & Planning — Develop, implement, and optimize preventive and predictive maintenance plans. Lead the IL6S PM Pillar development and ensure strategy quality and compliance.
Reliability Analysis & RCA — Lead root cause analyses (RCA) and reliability studies to identify and eliminate recurring equipment failures. Conduct Life Cycle Cost (LCC) analyses and feed insights into the CAPEX roadmap.
Competence Development — Drive training and capability building within the maintenance team and among Line Technical Leads in preventive maintenance methodology, Progressive Maintenance (PM) methods, and SAP PM usage.
Continuous Improvement & Projects — Actively lead and participate in improvement projects, systematically eliminate operational disruptions, and contribute to the continuous development of the maintenance function.
Project Management — Drive maintenance-related projects and act as requirements owner in investment projects related to maintainability and maintenance safety.
Spare Parts Management — Optimize spare parts handling, ensure inventory accuracy, and drive efficient use of resources.
KPI Tracking & Analysis — Compile, analyze, and report maintenance KPIs including MTBB (Mean Time Between Breakdowns), equipment reliability, and % TBM/CBM completion.
Calibration Ownership — Own and continuously develop the calibration program in collaboration with the Quality department.
Cost Management — Analyze and follow up on maintenance costs — including the balance between reactive and preventive maintenance — to identify improvement opportunities and ensure cost efficiency.
Quality Assurance — Ensure all maintenance work meets quality requirements per GMP standards and owns the maintenance routines that describe how work is performed.

What You'll Bring
Degree in Mechanical, Electrical, or Industrial Engineering (or equivalent experience)
Proven experience in maintenance engineering within a manufacturing environment, preferably FMCG
Strong knowledge of preventive and predictive maintenance strategies
Experience with root cause analysis (RCA) and reliability methodologies and Life Cycle Cost (LCC) analyses.
Familiarity with IL6S / TPM / World Class Manufacturing principles
Strong analytical skills and experience working with maintenance KPIs
Project management experience
Excellent communication and collaboration skills
Fluent in Swedish and English

What We Offer
A key role in Asset Reliability organization at a world-class manufacturing site
The opportunity to shape and drive the maintenance strategy with real impact on operational performance
A collaborative environment where you work closely with PM Planners, CI Engineers, Process Engineers, and QA
Development opportunities within Mondelēz International's global network
Competitive compensation and benefits package

Health & Benefits
﻿Friskvårdsbidrag (wellness allowance), on-site gym.
Food & Shopping
Subsidized lunch in our canteen and favorable discounts in our staff shop.
Easy Everyday Life
Fenced parking for all on-site employees and comprehensive employee support for health, work, and private life.
Security
Collective agreement and contractual insurance.
Community
Art association and social activities.
Work schedule: 100%

Strong position. Bigger ambitions. Want to be part of it?
🕐 Full-time
📍 Stockholm HQ at Glashuset, Slussen
🌍 Hybrid – 3 days a week at the office
📅 Start date: As soon as possible
Sweden is our home market and where it all started – and we still see significant room to grow. With an established platform, a strong Nordic brand and an AI-powered product, there are new customers to win, deals to develop and market share to take.
We’re growing our sales team in Stockholm and are now looking for several commercially driven Account Managers with an entrepreneurial mindset who want to help take us further.
What will you do?
This is a new business role, and sales is your primary focus. You’ll be responsible for winning new customers in the Swedish market, from the first conversation to a signed deal. You’ll identify opportunities, open doors with decision-makers and build long-term customer relationships – primarily through online meetings.
This means proactive prospecting, meaningful business conversations and the ability to turn customer challenges into valuable solutions. You’ll work closely with colleagues across sales, marketing and customer success at our Stockholm HQ.
But we also want your ideas. Which customers should we be talking to? Where are the biggest opportunities? How can we improve the way we sell? You’ll have the opportunity to help shape the answers.
Who are we looking for?
We’re looking for someone with a proven track record of winning new B2B customers who enjoys owning the entire sales process.
We believe you:
Have strong business acumen. You understand your customers’ businesses, challenge their perspectives, and sell business value rather than product features.
Have drive and a winning mentality. You create your own opportunities, enjoy closing deals, and have the persistence to reach your goals.
Think entrepreneurially. You take initiative, find new ways forward, and are comfortable building and improving things along the way.
Build trust. You’re curious, a good listener, and confident engaging with senior decision-makers.
Take ownership. You work in a structured way, own your pipeline and results, learn from setbacks, and contribute to the team’s success.

You have experience in consultative B2B sales, preferably within SaaS or similar solutions, and are comfortable working with CRM systems. You’re fluent in Swedish and have good English communication skills.
About Mynewsdesk
We are the leading AI-powered PR and communications platform in Scandinavia and the DACH region. Since 2003, we have helped more than 15,000 organisations, from small businesses to established brands, create and distribute impactful PR content and measure its success. Around 80,000 pieces of content are published on our platform every year, which attracts 1.6 million visitors each month.
What do we offer?
You’ll have the opportunity to make a real impact in our home market, backed by an established SaaS platform, talented colleagues and an international organisation. We offer a competitive base salary, attractive performance-based compensation, and the opportunity to influence both your own results and how we grow our business in Sweden.
💡An innovative product with a clear vision and a strong purpose
🏙️ A modern office with an incredible view at Glashuset, Slussen, in central Stockholm
🤝 Close collaboration with sales, marketing and customer success colleagues at HQ
👶 Parental pay top-up to 90% of your salary for up to 90 days
🧘 SEK 5,000 wellness allowance per year + a weekly wellness hour
🏖️ 30 days of paid vacation
🛡️ Occupational pension
At Mynewsdesk, we value curiosity, initiative and collaboration. We believe in taking ownership, challenging the way things are done, and helping each other succeed.
Can you spot a business opportunity, build a relationship, and turn it into a great deal? Then we’d love to meet you.

Hemfrid is Sweden’s largest home cleaning company. We help our customers with cleaning, window cleaning, and other home services – always with quality and care.
We are now looking for you who want to work as a Deep Cleaner / Move-out Cleaner in our OneTime team in Helsingborg. With us, you will become part of an international team with colleagues from all over the world, together delivering world-class service!
What do we offer?

A 75% position

Collective agreement and secure employment conditions

Fixed monthly salary – the same salary every month

Mileage compensation between customers if you use your own car for work

Paid travel time between customers

Free training in home cleaning and further education in service and cleaning

Enjoys working in a team with other colleagues

Has previous experience in cleaning

Is committed and wants to develop within cleaning

Previous experience as a home cleaner, housekeeper, or similar is highly meritorious.
As a Deep Cleaning and Move-Out Cleaner, you often work in teams, meet new customers and environments every day, and are confident in taking responsibility for both the execution and final quality assessment of the cleaning.
Our process
As part of our recruitment process, we conduct background checks. To be eligible for this position, you need to have a Swedish personal identity number or coordination number.
Apply today! ✨

We look forward to hearing from you!

Give your career a new dimension

Core mission:
The Institut Laue-Langevin (ILL), situated in Grenoble, France, is Europe's leading research facility for fundamental research using neutrons. The ILL operates the brightest neutron source in the world and hosts over 2000 visits by scientists per year, who come to carry out world-class research.
Within the Applied Science group (AS, 18 people) of ILL's Science Division, you will act as instrument technician for the new ThRILL thermal neutron imaging instrument, which will enter user operation in 2027, and TENIS, an irradiation instrument serving academic and industrial needs.

Your tasks:
In this context, you will:
- Ensure the smooth operation and maintenance of ThRILL and TENIS, which are located in building ILL5, level C, at the reactor neutron source.
- Coordinate the work of ILL services involved in these activities.
- Assist the ILL scientists responsible for ThRILL and TENIS with the preparation and conducting of experiments, typically together with scientific and industrial users.
- Propose technical improvements and, where appropriate, implement these improvements with the assistance of ILL services.
-Help to ensure compliance with ILL and instrument safety regulations, in particular radiation protection regulations.
-Become a valued member of the Applied Science group and support your colleagues and users where needed and appropriate.

Your profile:
- You have a Level 4-6 qualification (e.g. BTEC HNC/HND, undergraduate degree or equivalent) in mechanical engineering, applied physics and instrumentation or equivalent.
-You have at least two years of professional experience in the same area.
-You have experience in the manufacture, assembly and alignment of precision mechanical, electronic and optical assemblies.
-You are proficient in the use of CAD software.
-Ideally, you also have some knowledge of computing, electronics and electricity to allow you to take part in other technical projects.
-You have a practical approach to your work and are keen to learn new skills.
-You are an excellent team player but are also capable of working independently on a wide variety of projects.
- You are able to work meticulously and provide support to in-house and visiting scientists.

What we offer:
Quality of life - This position is based in Grenoble, a hub for research and technology, ideally located in the heart of the French Alps (just 3 hours from Paris/Provence by train, 1 hour from Lyon international airport and 1 ½ hours from Geneva). It is important for us that our staff achieve a healthy work-life balance. We therefore offer home working (under certain conditions), generous annual paid leave entitlement and a host of other benefits that you will discover when you arrive!

Prospects - We guarantee you a secure permanent position based in Grenoble in a multicultural scientific environment.

Benefits - We offer generous social benefits (expatriation allowance, excellent health cover), moving and relocation assistance (under certain conditions) and an annual productivity bonus. We also offer language courses for you and your partner and subsidies for the use of public transport and the staff canteen, as well as for holidays and a variety of cultural and sports activities. For more information, please visit https://www.ill.eu/careers/working-at-the-ill/employment-condition

Sounds interesting?
Then why not take your next career step with us by applying online - preferably in English - via our career portal by 22.11.2026, quoting reference number 26/50.
Please note that all applicants are subject to administrative screening (background checks). For this post, medical fitness for work under ionising radiation is required.
We are committed to equal opportunities and diversity and therefore welcome applications from all suitably qualified candidates.

research facility for basic research with neutrons. United by our passion for progress and
technology, we drive science and research forward every day. Together, we can pave the way
for discoveries that will help to make our world a better place.

Veritaz is a leading IT staffing solutions provider in Sweden, committed to advancing individual careers and aiding employers in ensuring the perfect talent fit. With a proven track record of successful partnerships with top companies, we have rapidly grown our presence in the USA, Europe, and Sweden as a dependable and trusted resource within the IT industry.
 Job Overview
Role Summary
An experienced Workplace Technology Technical Lead is needed for a consulting assignment within a large organisation operating a complex IT environment. The role provides technical leadership for the digital workplace, Microsoft 365, client platforms and mobile devices. The assignment focuses on driving sustainable technical development and improvements that enhance productivity, user experience, stability and security.
You will work closely with business stakeholders, internal IT teams, suppliers and global IT functions. This is a technical leadership and advisory role with significant influence over technical direction, strategic choices and the long-term evolution of workplace technology. The role does not include day-to-day operations or operational delivery; instead, it complements existing suppliers and global governance functions without assuming their delivery, budget or resource responsibilities.
Key Responsibilities
Set and drive the technical direction for workplace technology, including developing, anchoring and following up a technical roadmap with dependencies, risks and agreed actions.
Identify improvement opportunities and recommend priorities to reduce technical debt and complexity while improving productivity, automation and user experience.
Lead technical analyses and risk assessments for investments and changes, producing recommendations and reviewing decision material based on business impact, security, supportability, cost and user value.
Define requirements for, challenge and follow up supplier and global IT team technical commitments, quality and documentation in collaboration with contract, service and delivery owners.
Represent business needs and the user perspective in CAB, Global CAB and other relevant decision-making forums.
Provide technical support during major incidents, problem investigations and complex changes, and recommend sustainable long-term corrective actions.
Contribute to technical documentation, knowledge transfer and internal capability development, working with ITSM stakeholders on lifecycle management.
Act as a technical advisor to internal IT functions and relevant service and decision owners.
Make technical decisions within defined frameworks and delegated authority, clearly communicating recommendations, risks, alternatives and required decision conditions.
Recommend additional analysis, conditions, postponement or escalation when decision material or risk management is insufficient.

Technical Stack & Requirements
Deep knowledge of Microsoft Intune, endpoint management, Windows client platforms and mobile device management.
Strong understanding of Microsoft 365 and the interaction between productivity, collaboration, endpoint and security capabilities.
Experience with technical governance, architecture principles, standardisation and lifecycle management.
Experience with established IT service management processes, including incident, problem and change management.
Knowledge of Microsoft 365 capabilities for security, collaboration and information management.
Experience with automation, analytics and proactive monitoring within the endpoint and digital workplace domain.
Exposure to licence optimisation, cost management, service follow-up, change management and user adoption.

Qualifications & Experience
The ideal candidate has several years of experience in technical leadership within digital workplace technology, client management or Microsoft 365 in a complex organisation. You should have experience of supplier governance, requirements management and follow-up of external and global deliveries, as well as the ability to translate business requirements into sustainable, secure and manageable technical solutions.
Experience from large, distributed or global organisations with substantial user populations and complex dependencies is required. A relevant Microsoft certification, or equivalent documented competence, is advantageous. The role requires an analytical and structured approach, the ability to prioritise complex dependencies and confidence in advising and guiding technical decisions without formal personnel responsibility.
Location
This is a consulting assignment for a large organisation with a complex and potentially global IT environment. Professional fluency in both Swedish and English, spoken and written, is required.

Company Description
Welcome to a world, where your ideas lead to something big. Welcome to Bosch!
Bosch Thermoteknik AB in Tranås develops, manufactures, and sells heat pumps for the European market. We are approximately 650 employees and form part of the large Bosch Group, which consists of approximately 417,000 employees worldwide.
We work with sustainable simplification of everyday life where the focus is on the environment, innovation, and development. In Tranås there is a production unit and a competence and development center. The heat pumps we manufacture draw energy from different sources - the mountain, the water, or the air. We work to constantly be at the forefront and contribute to sustainable energy and a better environment with the goal of creating a simplified everyday life for our customers. In short, we create technology that is "Invented for life".
Job Description
Your contribution to something big
The Electrical team at Bosch in Tranås, Sweden is looking for an intern who’s eager to learn and get hands-on experience. You’ll be introduced to cable harness design, building samples and prototypes, electrical testing, and how certification works (LVD and EMC). You’ll primarily support the team with practical and theoretical tasks and, as you grow, you may take ownership of selected topics with guidance from experienced colleagues.
Examples of tasks:
Set up heat pumps in our lab, run tests, and help summarize results in clear reports.
With support, review internal/external requirements and help translate them into practical electrical requirements (safety, legal, functional, cost).
Build simple harness samples and install electrical components in heat pumps.
Join lab troubleshooting sessions and assist with analyzing electrical issues.
Assist with EMC testing in our 5 m SAC EMC chamber and help with smaller EMC tests outside the chamber.
Occasionally accompany colleagues to external test institutes.
Help gather input for time plans.
Support purchasing by reviewing specifications and participating in supplier meetings.
Assist the manager with light administrative tasks.
Prepare presentations in PowerPoint.

 
Duration of the internship: 6 months preferably starting in March/April 2027
Qualifications
What distinguishes you
Currently studying in a field related to electrical engineering, physics, mechatronics, or similar; alternatively, mechanical engineering with interest and some exposure to electrical topics.
Basic familiarity with test equipment (e.g., multimeters, oscilloscopes, spectrum analyzers) is a plus – if you’re motivated, we’ll teach you.
Curious, hands-on, and collaborative, with a willingness to learn.
Good written and verbal communication skills in English.

Additional Information
What we offer you
Monetary compensation is included to support you during your internship
We can offer free accommodation in Tranås
To support your well-being, we provide a wellness contribution for use on fitness, sports, or wellness services
We cover your travel costs from your residence to Tranås, making relocation easier for you
You gain valuable experience working within an international company with global connections

At Bosch we understand that everyone has their own focus in life, whether it is about new professional challenges, training, and development, or more time for family, friends, and hobbies, whatever your goals are we are flexible. Let ‘s strike a balance. At Bosch, we believe everyone is different and that is what we love. Get inspired by a cooperative, open, respectful, and trustworthy workplace where you can be yourself and be enriched by the perspectives of our community around the globe.
Join us and feel the difference. #LikeABosch

jobs.occupation: We seek nurses for permanent positions in Snåsa in Norway
jobs.description:
Would you like a permanent nursing position with varied responsibilities and nature right outside your door?
On behalf of Snåsa Municipality in Trøndelag, Norway, we are seeking three registered nurses for permanent positions within the municipal healthcare and care services.
Here, you will enjoy a varied and meaningful workday, providing care and follow-up for patients both in home care services and in institutional settings. You will become part of a professional healthcare environment where nurses play a key role, with a high degree of autonomy, varied clinical responsibilities, and close collaboration with colleagues and other healthcare professionals.
At the same time, you will have the opportunity to live in a place where nature is never far away. Snåsa is located next to the Blåfjella-Skjækerfjella National Park, offering vast forests, mountains, and excellent opportunities for hiking, cycling, hunting, and fishing. With a population of approximately 2,100 people, Snåsa is also a welcoming community where it is easy to get to know people and feel at home.
About the position
As a Registered Nurse, you will have a varied workday caring for patients with different needs in both home care services and institutional care settings.
Typical responsibilities include:
Providing daily nursing care and professional follow-up to patients in home care services and/or institutional care
Observing, assessing, and documenting patients’ health conditions
Medication administration and treatment in accordance with applicable guidelines and regulations
Collaborating with other healthcare professionals, family members, and multidisciplinary teams
Contributing to quality improvement initiatives and the development of local routines and patient care pathways

The position involves shift work, including day, evening, and weekend shifts. You will have a significant level of professional responsibility and will work both independently and closely with other professional groups. High-quality, safe patient care is at the heart of everything, while maintaining a positive working environment built on collaboration, well-being, and good humor.
Qualifications
We are looking for someone who is professionally engaged, responsible, and enjoys working both independently and as part of a team.
Authorization as a registered nurse in an EU or EEA country
Good communication skills in English and willingness to learn Norwegian
Valid police clearance and health certificate including tuberculosis and MRSA before starting
Valid driver’s licence (Class B)
Professionally engaged and responsible
Strong teamwork and adaptability skills
Experience from elderly care, home care services, or rehabilitation is an advantage

We offer
Permanent employment with competitive terms and conditions
Free Norwegian language training provided
A stable and predictable working environment
Varied and meaningful nursing responsibilities
A supportive and collaborative team environment, including guidance when needed
Excellent opportunities for professional development and continuing education
Attractive municipal pension and insurance schemes through KLP
Additional compensation for evening, night, and weekend work
Support and follow-up from Dignus Medical throughout the application and employment process
Support with housing and relocation when needed

Life in Snåsa
Snåsa is located in the northern part of Trøndelag, along the E6 highway and the Nordland Railway, approximately 50 minutes from Steinkjer. The municipality has around 2,100 residents and is ideal for those who wish to live close to nature while being part of a small and welcoming community. The area offers an active sports and cultural scene, shops, cafés, and excellent opportunities for outdoor activities all year round.
For those relocating with family, the municipality offers good capacity in kindergartens, schools, and after-school programs, as well as a variety of leisure activities for children and families. Trondheim Airport Værnes is approximately two hours away by car, and the Nordland Railway also provides convenient transportation to and from Snåsa.

We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.

jobs.occupation: Manager – Programs, Projects & Product Cost Competitiveness
jobs.description:
Manager – Programs, Projects & Product Cost Competitiveness
About the role
We are looking for an experienced and business-oriented Manager – Programs, Projects & Product Cost Competitiveness to lead and develop a team of five Program and Project Managers.
This role combines people leadership, program execution, and cost competitiveness. You will ensure that key development, industrialization, improvement, and transformation initiatives are delivered with clear ownership, strong execution, and measurable business impact.
A central part of the role is driving our Value Analysis / Value Engineering (VAVE) agenda, identifying and implementing opportunities to reduce product and manufacturing costs while maintaining or improving quality, reliability, and customer value.
You will work closely with Engineering, Operations, Purchasing, Quality, Sales, and Finance to turn business priorities into successful programs and projects.
Key responsibilities
Lead the Program & Project Management organization
Lead, coach, and develop a team of five Program and Project Managers.
Establish effective ways of working, governance, and project management standards.
Ensure projects are prioritized, resourced, and executed according to business needs.
Support teams in managing risks, resolving issues, and improving project performance.
Drive a culture of accountability, ownership, and continuous improvement.

Program Management & Strategic Execution
Translate business strategy into executable programs and projects.
Maintain program and project roadmaps and manage priorities and dependencies.
Ensure projects are aligned with strategic and financial objectives.
Monitor progress, risks, resources, costs, and expected benefits.
Provide transparent reporting and facilitate timely decision-making.

Drive VAVE & Cost Competitiveness
Establish and lead a structured VAVE process across products and manufacturing.
Identify and prioritize cost-reduction opportunities with measurable business impact.
Lead cross-functional workshops and initiatives involving Engineering, Operations, Purchasing, Quality, and Finance.
Drive Design-to-Cost and Design-for-Manufacturing activities.
Build and maintain a pipeline of cost-saving initiatives and ensure benefits are tracked and realized.
Verify savings together with Finance while safeguarding quality, reliability, and customer requirements.

Cross-functional Leadership
Build strong collaboration across functions.
Drive fact-based decision-making and root-cause problem solving.
Challenge existing solutions and encourage continuous improvement.
Ensure focus on speed, simplicity, and execution.

Hands-on Leadership
While primarily a leadership role, you will also take personal ownership of selected strategic and complex initiatives, including major transformation programs and critical VAVE projects.
Leadership expectations
We are looking for a leader who:
Takes ownership and delivers results.
Creates momentum and drives execution.
Makes decisions based on facts and business priorities.
Holds teams accountable while building trust and engagement.
Communicates clearly and effectively across the organization.
Leads through influence and develops people and capabilities.

Success in the role requires the ability to combine strategic thinking with hands-on execution.
Qualifications
Required
Several years of experience in Program Management, Project Management, Engineering, Operations, or a related industrial environment.
Proven track record of leading complex cross-functional initiatives.
Experience managing and developing people.
Strong knowledge of project and program management methodologies.
Experience with cost-reduction, VAVE, Design-to-Cost, or similar initiatives.
Strong business and financial understanding.
Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
Fluent in Swedish and English.

Preferred
Experience from manufacturing industries.
Engineering or technical university degree.
Experience with product development and industrialization.
Knowledge of Lean, continuous improvement, or operational excellence.
Experience with manufacturing processes and Design for Manufacturing/Assembly.
Familiarity with ERP, PLM, MES, or project management systems.
Project or Program Management certification.

Personal profile
You combine strong leadership capability, technical understanding, and business acumen. You are:
Results-oriented and structured.
Hands-on and action-focused.
Commercially minded and analytical.
Collaborative and influential.
Confident in challenging the status quo.
Decisive and comfortable driving change.

Most importantly, you have a strong ownership mentality and are motivated by turning opportunities into measurable business results.
Our mission
Lead people, programs, and projects that transform business priorities into measurable results while continuously improving the competitiveness and profitability of our products and operations through VAVE.

jobs.occupation: Global PV Risk Minimization Physician  Injectable Aesthetics
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Global PV Risk Minimization Physician to join our Global Pharmacovigilance organisation within Injectable Aesthetics.
This is an influential global role for a physician with deep expertise in medical device vigilance, risk management, and post-marketing safety. You will provide medical and scientific leadership across Galderma's portfolio of injectable aesthetic medical devices, helping ensure that patient safety and benefit-risk considerations remain at the centre of product lifecycle management and strategic decision-making.
Working in a highly collaborative international environment, you will partner with colleagues across Pharmacovigilance, Clinical Development, Medical Affairs, Regulatory Affairs, Quality, and Commercial teams. Together, you will shape safety strategies, guide regulatory interactions, and contribute to decisions that impact healthcare professionals and patients worldwide.
This is a unique opportunity to combine scientific expertise, strategic thinking, and cross-functional leadership in one of the most innovative and rapidly evolving areas of dermatology.
 
Your mission
As Global PV Risk Minimization Physician, you will provide medical leadership for post-marketing safety and risk management activities across Galderma's Injectable Aesthetics medical device portfolio.
You will play a key role in shaping global safety strategies, leading benefit-risk evaluations, and driving initiatives that support the safe use of our products throughout their lifecycle. Working in close partnership with colleagues across Pharmacovigilance, Clinical Development, Medical Affairs, Regulatory Affairs, Quality, and Commercial teams, you will contribute scientific expertise that informs critical business and regulatory decisions.

In this role, you will:
·      Lead medical assessments of safety data, emerging signals, and benefit-risk profiles.
·      Drive risk minimisation strategies and support their implementation globally.
·      Provide expert input into regulatory submissions, safety reports, and product labelling.
·      Support interactions with Health Authorities, Competent Authorities, and Notified Bodies.
·      Contribute to safety governance and cross-functional decision-making.
·      Strengthen inspection readiness and support a culture of compliance, patient safety, and continuous improvement.
·      Act as a trusted scientific partner across the organisation and help shape the future of Injectable Aesthetics at Galderma.
 
Your profile 
You are a physician with a passion for patient safety and a strong scientific mindset. Drawing on extensive experience in medical device safety, vigilance, risk management, or related post-marketing activities, you combine deep medical expertise with the ability to navigate complex global environments and build strong partnerships across functions, cultures, and geographies.
You are comfortable translating complex scientific data into clear recommendations and practical actions, influencing stakeholders at different levels, and balancing strategic thinking with operational execution. With strong scientific judgement, a collaborative approach, and high ethical standards, you thrive in a dynamic international environment where patient safety, quality, and compliance are at the centre of decision-making.
 
What you'll bring:
Medical Doctor (MD) qualification.
10-15 years of relevant experience within global medical device safety, vigilance, risk management, or related post-marketing activities.
Strong knowledge of benefit-risk assessment, signal detection, safety surveillance, and risk minimization.
Solid understanding of global medical device regulations and vigilance requirements.
Experience interacting with Health Authorities, Competent Authorities, and/or Notified Bodies.
Knowledge of epidemiology, statistics, and safety data evaluation.
Strong analytical skills and the ability to interpret complex safety data and translate insights into action.
Proven ability to lead initiatives and influence stakeholders within a global matrix organization.
Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to engage effectively across functions and cultures.
A proactive, adaptable, and solutions-oriented mindset.
Fluency in written and spoken English.

 
Additional qualifications in Clinical Pharmacology, Drug Safety, Public Health, Epidemiology, Biomedical Engineering, or related disciplines are considered an advantage.
 
Location and information 
This position is based on-site in Uppsala, Sweden. 
 
Why Galderma
At Galderma, you'll have the opportunity to work in a science-driven, innovative, and collaborative environment where quality and patient impact are at the center of everything we do. You'll join a team of talented colleagues and play an important role in supporting the continued growth of our biologics and protein-based portfolio.
